useCase: Detecting physically impossible 反射s in AI生成の images, especially in eyes and glossy surfaces
mechanism: 分析します specular highlights and 反射s in eyes, glasses, metallic surfaces, and water for physical consistency. チェックします that 反射 geometry matches the scene's light source positions and object arrangements. AI models frequently generate physically impossible 反射s that violate optical laws.
accuracy: 中 - 70-82% on images with visible reflective surfaces
name: 反射整合性分析
source: O'Brien & Farid (2012) - Exposing Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Reflections, ACM TOMM
algorithm: Specular Highlight Analysis + Reflection Symmetry Check
parameters: Detection: specular highlight segmentation, Eye 反射: corneal 反射 分析, Surface: BRDF consistency check, Symmetry: bilateral 反射 matching
description: 調査します 反射s in eyes, glasses, and surfaces for physical 精度. AI models frequently generate physically impossible or inconsistent 反射s.

references.title: O'Brien, J.F. & Farid, H. (2012). Exposing Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Reflections. ACM TOMM.
Hu, S. et al. (2021). Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights. ICASSP.

strengths:
• Based on physical optics laws
• Very effective for face/portrait 分析
• Eye 反射s are strong 真正性 indicators
• 検出します subtle physical impossibilities
limitations:
• Requires visible reflective surfaces
• Low-解像度 images reduce 検出 ability
• Complex scenes with multiple 反射s are challenging
• Not applicable to matte/diffuse surfaces
